content.title: Why Proto Labs (PRLB) Stock Is Nosediving
content.summary: Shares of manufacturing services provider Proto Labs (NYSE:PRLB) fell 13.8% in the afternoon session after the company's third-quarter results was overshadowed by underlying concerns about its long-term growth and profitability. The digital manufacturing services provider reported third-quarter revenue of $135.4 million, up 7.8% year on year, and an adjusted profit of $0.47 per share, both beating Wall Street estimates.
